mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, cr.id AS compatibility_result_id, cs.first_goal_type, cs.target_amount, cs.target_period_months, r.expected_asset, r.expert_comment FROM member me INNER JOIN couple c ON c.inviter_id = me.id OR c.invitee_id = me.id INNER JOIN compatibility_result cr ON cr.couple_id = c.id INNER JOIN report r ON r.compatibility_result_id = cr.id INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE me.id = #{memberId} AND me.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.birth_date,
ps.annual_income, ps.monthly_available_amount, ps.financial_knowledge, ps.capital_preservation_attitude,
COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX( CASE psie.investment_experience WHEN 'LOW_RISK' THEN 1 WHEN 'MODERATE_LOW_RISK' THEN 2 WHEN 'MODERATE_RISK' THEN 3 WHEN 'MODERATE_HIGH_RISK' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH_RISK' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END ) FROM personal_survey_investment_experience psie WHERE psie.personal_survey_id = ps.id ), 0 ) AS investment_experience_score,
fs.financial_asset, fs.total_debt, fs.annual_debt_payment,
pia.has_isa, pia.has_irp, pia.has_pension_saving, pia.isa_annual_deposit, pia.irp_annual_payment, pia.dc_annual_payment, pia.pension_annual_payment FROM couple c INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = c.inviter_id OR m.id = c.invitee_id LEFT JOIN personal_survey ps ON ps.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN financial_summary fs ON fs.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN pension_isa_account pia ON pia.member_id = m.id WHERE c.id = #{coupleId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
